title: Five-dimensional thick branes in the scalar representation of $f(Q,B)$ gravity
summary: One examines a codimension-one thick braneworld in the scalar representation of $f(Q,B)$ gravity, where $Q$ is the nonmetricity scalar, and $B$ is the boundary term satisfying $R=Q-B$. We write the gravitational sector in terms of two auxiliary scalar fields, $\varphi=f_Q$ and $ψ=f_B$, and an interaction potential $U(\varphi,ψ)$ obtained by a Legendre transformation from the $f(Q,B)$ function. Working in the coincident gauge and assuming a five-dimensional warped geometry with four-dimensional Poincaré symmetry, we derive the complete set of brane equations sourced by a canonical bulk scalar…
